import pandas as pd
# Load TGA data and calculate Fe equivalent residue at 800C
tga_file = 'data/tga_batches.xlsx'
run_file = 'data/run_log.xlsx'

# Get all sheets from TGA file
xl_tga = pd.ExcelFile(tga_file)
sheets = xl_tga.sheet_names

results = []
for sheet in sheets:
    df_sheet = pd.read_excel(tga_file, sheet_name=sheet)
    # Find index closest to 800 C
    temp_col = '온도 (°C)'
    weight_col = '중량 (%)'
    idx_800 = (df_sheet[temp_col] - 800).abs().idxmin()
    residue_800 = df_sheet.loc[idx_800, weight_col]
    fe_equiv = residue_800 * 0.699
    run_id = sheet
    results.append({'런ID': run_id, 'TGA_Fe_wt%': fe_equiv})

tga_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
